description_en: Resets the password of a database account in a specified ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
description_zh: 重置指定云数据库ClickHouse集群的指定数据库账号密码
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse reset-account-password --db-cluster-id cc-bp108z124a8o70000 --account-name test --account-password 123456Ff --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetAccountPassword

parameters.help_en:
The new password for the database account.

> - The password must contain characters from at least three of the following types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.

- The special characters are !@#$%^&\*()\_+-=

- The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号的新密码。
>- 由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的任意三种组成。
- 特殊字符为!@#$%^&*()_+-=
- 长度为8~32个字符
parameters.name: account_password
